decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint sits close to the firm's core pipeline-fitting knowledge, so the firm can interpret results and improve it, and its promotion to a page of its own in 2019 signals commitment.

Public waste bins lie far from the firm's water-infrastructure know-how, and with no evident R&D the firm has little related knowledge to assimilate market feedback, so the product is likely to be abandoned in favour of the core business.
The waste bin with ashtray is a distant street-furniture product outside the firm's absorptive base, making learning and improvement difficult and a withdrawal likely.

Outdoor public ashtrays are distant from the firm's pipeline expertise and are not supported by in-house research, so the firm can hardly build on them and will likely redirect resources to its established offer.
